[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/04 (Sat) 21:05  
[FACT] User is working on a big project with a Tokyo-based startup.  
[FACT] User has been busy with this project for the past few weeks.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for recommendations on productivity tools to manage time more efficiently.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on landing the project with the Tokyo-based startup.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended Trello as a visual project management tool that uses boards, lists, and cards to organize tasks.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended ClickUp as an all-in-one project management tool that includes task management, time tracking, and collaboration features.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended Toggl as a simple and user-friendly time tracking tool that helps track time spent on tasks, projects, and clients.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended RescueTime as a time management tool that tracks how time is spent on devices, providing insights into productivity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended Harvest as a time tracking and invoicing tool that helps track time spent on projects and generate invoices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended Freedom as a tool that helps stay focused by blocking distracting websites and apps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended Pomodoro Timer as a time management technique involving focused 25-minute increments of work with breaks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended StayFocusd as a Chrome extension that limits access to distracting websites.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended Slack as a communication platform for teams.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended Google Workspace (formerly G Suite) for collaboration with tools like Gmail, Google Drive, Google Docs, and Google Sheets.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended Notion as an all-in-one workspace for notes, databases, and collaboration.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested prioritizing tasks, setting realistic goals, and taking breaks as additional tips for productivity.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended Toggl as a time tracking tool that allows tracking time across multiple projects and clients.
